description: Reified 'Professional Activity' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Actor in Professional Activity.description: This field is used to link the documented actor's professional activity to other actors  involved in carrying it out.

Location of Professional Activity.description: This field is used to link the documented actor's professional activity to a location at which it was carried out.

Professional Activity Type.description: This field is used to record the formal type of the documented actor's professional activity.

Source Reference Work for Professional A.description: This field is used to link the documented actor's professional activity to a textual source which documents the professional itself.

Date of Professional Activity.description: This field is used to link the documented actor's professional activity to an instance of time-span recording the temporal extent of the activity.
